inlines.v: SWARTH, sworth, adjective 1. Being of a dark hue; moderately black; tawny. A nation strange with visage swart. [I believe swart and swarth are never used in the United States, certainly not in New England. Swarthy is a common word.] 2. Gloomy; malignant. [Not in use.] SWART, verb transitive To make tawny.
